definitions.gloss: residual heat (of food just after cooking)
definitions.explanation: The heat food still holds right after it comes off the heat. Almost always in the recipe phrase meaning 'let it cool slightly', until it is no longer hot to the touch.

examples.japanese: {粗熱|あらねつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧。
{粗熱|あらねつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{取|と}れたら→取れる：02376_toreru⟧⟦{冷蔵庫|れいぞうこ}→冷蔵庫：01046_reizouko⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: Once it has cooled a little, put it in the fridge.

examples.japanese: {焼|や}き{上|あ}がった⟦ケーキ→ケーキ：01356_keeki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{型|かた}→型：02146_kata⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{出|だ}して→出す：01087_dasu⟧、⟦{網|あみ}→網：22587_ami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{粗熱|あらねつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}って→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Take the baked cake out of the tin and let it cool slightly on a rack.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {粗熱|あらねつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to let cool slightly (until warm, not hot)
- {粗熱|あらねつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{取|と}れる→取れる：02376_toreru⟧: to cool down slightly
- {粗熱|あらねつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{取|と}れる→取れる：02376_toreru⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{置|お}く→置く：01092_oku⟧: to leave until slightly cooled

USAGE:
A recipe word. {粗熱|あらねつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ means cooling to around body temperature, not cooling completely; for that, recipes say ⟦{冷|さ}ます→冷ます：02113_samasu⟧ or ⟦しっかり→しっかり：01272_shikkari⟧⟦{冷|ひ}やす→冷やす：02403_hiyasu⟧. The reason is often to avoid warming the fridge or melting something added next.
